sections.description: ST SEO Consultant is a sleek, modern and fully responsive WordPress theme designed for SEO consultants, SEO experts and specialists, search engine optimization agencies, digital marketing agencies, PPC and paid media strategists, Google Ads and SEM managers, content marketing and copywriting teams, link building and outreach professionals, social media marketing and email marketing experts, lead generation and growth marketing consultants, web design studios, IT and business consulting firms, startups, freelancers, small businesses and corporate brands that want to establish credibility and showcase their expertise online. Its bold orange and black color scheme conveys confidence and professionalism, while the clean, minimal and well structured layout helps present your portfolio, case studies, client testimonials, pricing plans, service pages, landing pages and blog articles with clarity. The theme suits a marketing agency website, personal branding site, one page business profile, creative studio, startup landing page, coaching and mentoring practice, finance, legal, real estate, insurance, healthcare, education, travel, photography, fitness, construction, automotive, restaurant, ecommerce and online store projects. Built for flexibility and ease of use, ST SEO Consultant integrates seamlessly with the Elementor page builder, MetForm contact form, ST Elementor Addon and WooCommerce, and works well with popular plugins such as Contact Form 7, Yoast SEO and Rank Math, enabling drag and drop customization, dynamic content and no code editing. It is compatible with the Gutenberg block editor and the WordPress Customizer live preview, and supports custom logo, custom header, custom background, custom colors, custom menu, featured images, widget ready sidebars and footer widget areas, sticky posts, threaded comments and full width templates. Clean semantic code, schema friendly markup, optimized Core Web Vitals, fast page speed, cross browser compatibility, mobile first responsive design, retina ready graphics, translation ready strings and a lightweight framework help improve SERP rankings, organic traffic, conversion rate optimization and overall user experience, allowing both beginners and experienced users to build professional, mobile friendly websites that look great on desktop, laptop, tablet and phone.
